description: This file defines an interface class 'IEventHandler' with pure virtual functions meant for handling various runtime, window, ripple, and state change events within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class providing event handler method signatures for runtime, window, ripple, and state change events.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events, accepting a JsonObject with event data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events, accepting a JsonObject with event data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events, accepting a string name and JsonObject with event data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events, accepting a JsonObject with event data.
